kapak.alt: Implants at age two and under

youtube.baslik: Under what conditions is an implant covered for a child under two? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In Türkiye, the national reimbursement rules (SUT) require a sensorineural loss over 90 dB HL in both ears for children aged two and under; a medical board report must state no benefit from at least three months of hearing aid use in both ears. The cost of an implant placed before twelve months of age is not covered. The candidacy decision is made by the team. This is not legal advice; check the current legislation.
youtube.kapanis_metni: Follow AIHEAR Audiology Academy for more quick facts.
